responsibility: This implementation module provides the GNU Modula-2 runtime implementation of Logitech-compatible word-level bit manipulation. Using SYSTEM.BITSET, SHIFT, ROTATE, and direct byte-addressing of WORD storage, it implements bit-field extraction and update, logical AND/OR/XOR/NOT, logical and arithmetic shifts, rotates, and byte-order helper routines that either derive a high/low byte or reverse the bytes of a WORD.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of BitWordOps: unlike BitWordOps.def, it executes the WORD operations with BITSET, SHIFT, and ROTATE and uses raw BYTE views of WORD storage for HighByte, LowByte, and Swap.
